sentence: This project studies how a protein made by a mutation changes epigenetic circuits so that cells can turn into leukemia.
This project studies how a protein that promotes leukemia is broken down when a medicine disrupts microtubules.
This project builds deep learning models that use images and clinical data to predict who will respond to immunotherapy for gastric cancer.
This project builds a wrist-worn device that uses deep-learning algorithms to measure blood pressure without a cuff.
This project builds an artificial intelligence framework that combines many data types to find molecular regulators of brain aging and Alzheimer’s Disease.
This project tests whether engineered heart tissue that conducts electricity is safe and works in animal models of heart injury.
This project studies how endogenous cannabinoids control the pain linked to alcohol withdrawal.
This project studies enzymes called halogenases that add halogen atoms to indoles and alkynes for use in medicinal chemistry.
This project builds small molecules that block a protein that stops leukemic cells from differentiating.
This project builds computational tools to study how extrachromosomal DNA changes over time in tumors.
This project tests a microwave imaging device with a flexible 3D sensor and deep learning to screen for breast cancer.
This project tests whether peptides made when a protein malfunctions trigger T cell responses in a type of frontotemporal dementia.
This project tries to find out what predicts stomach cancer risk, which is often caused by Helicobacter pylori infection.
This project supports researchers attending conferences on electrophysiology and kinesiology.
This project studies how microtubule structures inside heart muscle cells change as the heart adapts to its environment.
This project studies how genes shape human milk composition and how milk links to the health of mothers and infants.
This project tests whether a lack of progranulin harms brain cells and immune cells in mice with lupus.
This project builds a catheter-based device that images coronary plaque and a fluorescent marker of inflammation.
This project builds a biomimetic model of the lower reproductive tract to study chlamydia and gonorrhea infections.
This project builds a machine learning model to find children with asthma at highest risk and tests an integrated social and asthma care intervention.
